style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven handsome face with fine elven features and a straight, slim, normal-sized nose, lively expressive eyes, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a lute on his back, slim build. His face is full of life and follows the scene: shouting, laughing, fierce, cocky, scheming, grieving only when the scene grieves. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.silas: Silas, a lean human dock smuggler in his thirties: buzzed dark hair, stubble, sunken nervous eyes, drab grey-olive patched coat, rope belt, ink-stained fingers
cast.severin: Severin, a tall pale woman of the forest: very long straight silver-white hair, dark moss-green hooded ranger cloak, faint mint-green glowing eyes, calm unreadable face, a soft green light around her
cast.guildmen: two different burly trade-guild enforcers, clearly two distinct men: one bald and heavy-set with a short red beard, one taller with greasy black hair and a scar across the cheek; both in bright crimson red wool coats with brass guild badges, red angry faces, cudgels at their belts

shots.scene: Extreme close shot of a dying campfire at night in a pine forest, a few glowing logs and embers, behind it the warm-lit face and hands of Lucien Vale tuning his lute, eyes down, darkness all around
Medium close-up of Lucien Vale by a low campfire, looking up from his lute straight at the viewer as if about to tell a story, firelight on one side of his face, cold blue night on the other
Still life on a rough tavern table lit by one candle: two bone dice, a small cloth pouch of dark herbs and a glass vial, a few copper coins, deep shadows, painterly
A black pine forest at night swallowed by mist, between the trunks a single faint pale figure far away, barely visible, mint-green glimmer of eyes, ominous and quiet

Wide establishing shot at dusk of a hilly island coast, a small walled township of timber houses and smoking chimneys above a harbour, dark sea, red guild banners on the gate, last orange light on the clouds
Exterior of a crooked timber tavern at night, a painted sign with a black bird hanging over the door, warm light and smoke spilling out of the windows, wet cobbles reflecting the glow
Inside the tavern door looking in: a packed smoky tavern hall, a fireplace roaring at the back, silhouettes of drinkers raising mugs, a small stage in the light
Lucien Vale playing his lute on a small tavern stage, mid-song, head thrown back, a crowd of rough patrons cheering with raised mugs in the foreground, warm amber light
Daytime township street taken over by the trade guild: crimson banners on every house, merchant stalls, guild enforcers in crimson coats watching the crowd, poor townsfolk with heads down
Close shot from above of an upturned felt hat on cobbles with only one copper coin in it, Lucien's boots and lute case beside it, the crowd's legs passing by, grey light
A harbour at evening, blue hour, an empty stone berth where a ship should be, coils of rope and empty crates, black water with a moon reflection, a few lanterns on the quay
Silas the smuggler in the doorway of a cluttered harbour shed lit by a hanging lantern, clutching a small wrapped package to his chest, glancing over his shoulder, crates stacked high
Lucien Vale walking down a long wooden harbour quay at evening seen from behind, lute on his back, coat moving in the wind, lanterns and masts ahead, sea mist
Lucien Vale and Silas face to face in a lantern-lit harbour shed, Lucien holding out an open hand, smiling but insistent, Silas nervous and reluctant
Two guild enforcers in crimson coats bursting through a shed door shouting, pointing, low angle, lantern light behind them making long shadows
Tight close-up of the two guild enforcers' faces, red with anger and greed, veins on the forehead, gold guild badge, harsh lantern light
Extreme close-up of a slim hand with rings rolling two bone dice across a rough wooden table, both dice showing six, a sly glint of light on them
Lucien Vale leaning back on a stool smiling, raising one finger as if promising, the two crimson-coated guild enforcers across the table hesitating, grudging
The two guild enforcers walking away along a misty quay at night seen from behind, one looking back and spitting, lanterns fading into fog
Lucien Vale alone at the very end of a long wooden pier at night, small figure from far behind, a huge moon over a black sea, empty pockets turned out, sea mist
Close-up portrait of Lucien Vale with a brave tired smile despite a thin line of blood from a cut on his lip, warm eyes full of hurt he is hiding, moonlight and a warm rim light
Epic wide shot: Lucien Vale walking alone on a dirt road at night across a windswept island moor, long coat blowing, a huge silver moon, dark sea cliffs, a lone road stretching ahead

A dark road splitting a scene in two: on the left a black forest edge with the glowing yellow eyes of a pack of wolves, on the right a line of merchant wagons with crimson banners and torches, a lone traveller in the middle
Low angle heroic close shot of Lucien Vale against a stormy night sky, jaw set, hand on the glowing blue dagger at his belt, wind in his blond hair
A huge dark wooden warehouse at night by the harbour, its big doors half open, a thin slice of lantern light inside, stacked crates, two tall figures standing guard in the doorway in silhouette
Arthas the paladin in the doorway of a dark warehouse, arms crossed over his steel plate, dark hood, two burning eye slits in his helm, imposing, lantern behind him
Cedric Cold-Eye the monk leaning on his long wooden staff in a dark warehouse doorway, bronze dragon pauldron, pale cold grey eyes staring hard at the viewer, unimpressed

Tense standoff at a warehouse door at night: Arthas in dark plate and Cedric with his staff stand shoulder to shoulder blocking the doorway on the right, facing left; Lucien Vale on the left faces them in three-quarter view, one hand raised, pleading; a lantern on the ground between them, long shadows, all three bodies turned toward each other
Silas hunched over in the corner of a dark warehouse, clutching his head in agony, veins dark, eyes beginning to glow yellow, lantern on the floor tipped over

Horror close-up in a dark warehouse: Silas the smuggler, still recognisably human in his patched grey-olive coat, doubled over mid-transformation into a werewolf, coarse dark fur bursting through his torn sleeves and back, his face stretching into a wolf snout, wild glowing yellow eyes, flickering lantern light from below, painterly, dark, frightening not comical
In the shadows of a warehouse a huge hunched werewolf silhouette leaps onto a screaming man, only shapes and a spray of dark red in the lantern light, crates falling, leave the gore to imagination

A warehouse floor after violence, high angle, scattered crates and a toppled lantern, a dark red pool spreading over the planks reflecting the light, a still hand at the edge of the frame, no gore detail
Close-up of Lucien Vale's hands opening a small cloth bundle with seven tiny glass vials of dark liquid in a row, warm lantern light, blood specks on the cloth
Warehouse doors bursting open at night, a crowd of armed merchants in crimson coats with torches, swords and crossbows storming in, furious faces, torchlight and smoke
Lucien Vale casting a spell, whispering, a long jagged shard of glowing blue ice flying from his outstretched fingers toward an armed merchant, frost spreading in the air, blue light on his face
A merchant in a crimson coat frozen solid mid-stride, covered in blue ice and frost, his sword raised, torchlight glittering on the ice, other figures blurred behind
Arthas the paladin bringing his bronze-hilted longsword down in one massive blow on an armed merchant, sparks, motion, burning eye slits, dramatic low angle, torchlight
Surviving merchants fleeing through a dark harbour alley at night with torches, seen from behind, running into fog and darkness, one looking back in fear
The three half-brothers standing in the wrecked warehouse doorway at night, Lucien, Arthas and Cedric, looking out into the dark where torches of hunters glimmer far away

Epic wide shot: three brothers walking side by side down a moonlit dirt road on a windswept island at night, Lucien in the burgundy coat, Arthas in dark plate, Cedric with his staff, huge moon, dark sea
Wolves with glowing yellow eyes running between black pines at night on one side, a line of torch-carrying hunters in crimson coats on the other, mist between them
Low angle shot of the three brothers against a stormy night sky, Lucien in front, Arthas and Cedric behind him, silhouettes rimmed by moonlight
A township square at night filling with an angry crowd holding torches and pitchforks, timber houses, a church bell tower above, smoke and orange light
Close faces in an angry torch-lit crowd, shouting, fists raised, firelight and smoke, painterly
Lucien Vale standing on the steps of a small church before a torch-lit crowd, arms open, smiling like a preacher, a holy sun symbol carved over the door behind him
Arthas the paladin in profile turning his hooded helm away, shoulders heavy, in shadow at the edge of a torch-lit square, ashamed and silent
Silas tied with ropes to a wooden chair in a dark cellar, head hanging, a single candle, a hooded figure's hand on his forehead with a faint purple glow of magic
Inside a broken mind: a swirling dreamlike vision, a dark forest edge seen through a pale mist, the image warping like memory, mint-green light deep inside the trees

Severin standing at the edge of a black pine forest at night, very long silver-white hair, moss-green cloak, faint mint-green glowing eyes, soft green light around her, mist at her feet, beautiful and unsettling
A ruined ancient stone gate standing alone deep in a pine forest, a shimmering veil of mint-green light inside its arch, Severin a small dark figure beside it beckoning, mist
Extreme close-up of a woman's face half hidden in shadow and silver hair, only one pale mint-green glowing eye clearly visible, unreadable expression
Black pines in thick night fog, empty, the green light gone, only a few drifting fireflies, very dark and quiet

Wide shot of a small campfire in a dark pine clearing at night, three brothers sitting far apart around it not looking at each other, Lucien with his lute, Arthas staring into the fire, Cedric with his back turned
Arthas and Cedric by a low campfire at night, silent, faces lit from below by the embers, eyes on the ground, the paladin's helm off beside him

Close-up of Lucien Vale by a dying campfire, lute silent in his lap, looking past the viewer into the dark pines, the last embers lighting his face, a hint of mint-green light far behind him in the trees
The last red embers of a campfire going out in total darkness, a thin curl of smoke rising
